sections.h2: Where do you take a deed in Barry County, and what is staff allowed to help with?
sections.html:
Go to Room 102 at the Barry County Courthouse, 220 W State Street, Hastings, MI 49058. The office posts Monday to Friday hours from 8:15 to 4:45, shuts for the noon hour, and answers at 269-945-1289 or bcrod@barrycounty.org. Its page offers a useful reminder: filing a deed puts it in the public record without vouching for its legality.

Clerks record, index and preserve what arrives. They do not search titles, hand out blank forms or coach anyone on wording, so the deed itself comes from your closing agent or a lawyer. Nothing already on file can be altered, and a name added to or dropped from ownership means a brand-new deed gets signed and filed.

People sometimes ask for the "title" to a house. The county answers that most homes have none, since the recorded deed covers whatever is permanently fixed to the land. Certain mobile homes are the exception and may keep a separate title with the Secretary of State.

sections.h2: What are the Barry County recording charges, and who pays what?
sections.html:
A flat $30.00 covers any document, and each added instrument number that a paper assigns or discharges brings another $3.00. Sale deeds and similar transfers owe state and county transfer tax on top, collected during recording. One payment to the Register of Deeds can cover the fee and the tax together.

One item travels separately. Land contracts, their assignments, warranty deeds and any deed with a warranty covenant require a Tax Certification from the Barry County Treasurer, priced at $5.00, written as its own check to the treasurer.

Barry County charges posted on the register's recording and FAQ pages
ItemAmount
Recording a document$30.00
Each extra instrument assigned or discharged$3.00
Tax certification (check to Treasurer)$5.00
State transfer tax$3.75 per $500 or fraction
County transfer tax$0.55 per $500 or fraction
Copy by mail or email$1.00 per page, plus $5.00 search fee if no document number

The counter takes cash, checks, and debit or credit cards; cards add a small service fee.

sections.h2: What transfer tax goes with a Barry County sale?
sections.html:
In the register's FAQ, the seller carries the tax, set at $4.30 for every $500 of consideration, and it is due the moment the deed is recorded. Take $264,100, the 2020 to 2024 Census median for homes in Barry County. It holds 529 blocks of $500 after rounding up, so the tax lands at $2,274.70.

Some transfers escape the tax, though staff will not choose an exemption on your behalf. A deed claiming one must show MCL 207.505 (county) or MCL 207.526 (state) plus the exemption's letter, and the county posts separate lists for each. Have your closing agent make that call.

  • Family gifts to a son, daughter or grandchild sit among the state exemptions.
  • Foreclosure transfers, and deeds given to avoid foreclosure, are exempt from the state tax.
  • Deeds that fix a title flaw by confirming what the grantee already owns are exempt, along with any instrument priced under $100.

The full state list sits in MCL 207.526.

sections.h2: What does the Barry County office require on a deed?
sections.html:
State statutes set recording standards, and Barry posts a checklist drawn from them. Run through it before filing. These are the main points from the county's page.

  • Ink signatures in black or dark blue, original rather than copied, with each name typed or printed under it.
  • An acknowledgment taken by a judge, a court clerk or a notary in Michigan, with the notary's name typed on the signature page.
  • A street or post office address for each grantee, and the drafter's name and address.
  • A blank 2.5 inch strip at the top of page one, and half an inch of white space around the rest.
  • Readable black print no smaller than 10 point, on white 20 pound paper sized from 8.5 by 11 up to 8.5 by 14.
  • The property's full value stated in the deed, or a transfer tax valuation affidavit attached.
  • A certified death certificate recorded alongside, or ahead of, any deed that conveys by survivorship.

Photocopies are rejected. Court orders must carry the clerk's seal, and all other documents need original signatures.

sections.h2: What are the ways to file in Barry County, and when does the paper come back?
sections.html:
Walk it in, mail it, or route it through an e-recording company. Barry names five: Simplifile, Indecomm Global Services, Nationwide Title Clearing, EPN and CSC. A document sent by ordinary email is not recorded.

A paper that meets the standards is recorded the day it is received, according to the FAQ, and walk-in filers take the recorded copy home. Mail and drop-offs usually return in 2 to 4 business days. Enclose a stamped return envelope, or the office keeps the original for 90 days at least. Digital PDF returns through Swift are free and arranged with staff.

One catch from the county's page: the treasurer issues electronic tax certifications only via Simplifile and CSC. Confirm that your closing agent's provider fits before signing day.

sections.h2: Does the register handle property tax or foreclosure questions?
sections.html:
Property tax is outside the register's job. Its FAQ points owners to the city or township for current bills and to the Barry County Treasurer for delinquent amounts. If the parcel has back tax, get a payoff figure from the treasurer first.

Foreclosures reach the office only after the sale occurs, so staff cannot say whether a house is set for sheriff's sale. After a sheriff's deed is recorded, the office takes the redemption payment but does not compute it. Open liens show up in a title search, run at the public workstations or through a title firm.

For ownership questions the county suggests starting with its GIS property map. It follows the tax roll and shows the listed taxpayer, while the recorded deed settles who actually owns the parcel.

sections.h2: What is Barry County like for a seller?
sections.html:
The county spans 577 square miles, 553 of them land. Hastings serves as its lone city and its seat, with Freeport, Middleville, Nashville and Woodland as villages and Delton, Dowling and Hickory Corners as census-designated places. Neighbors include Kent and Allegan counties on the west and northwest, Kalamazoo to the southwest, Eaton to the east and Calhoun to the southeast.

No passenger trains run here, and the lone remaining line is a two-mile CSX stretch through Woodland Township. Drivers rely on M-37 to reach Hastings from the north and south, M-43 through Delton and Hastings, M-79 from Nashville toward Hastings, M-66 along the eastern side and M-89 and M-179 in the west and southwest.

  • Population estimate for 2025: 63,991, a 2.5 percent increase over 2020.
  • Housing units in 2025: 28,284, and 24,480 households.
  • Homeownership: 87.3 percent, and a median home value of $264,100.
  • Household income at the median: $77,500, with gross rent at the median of $972.
  • Mean commute: 27.7 minutes, and building permits in 2025: 157.

With a mean commute near 28 minutes, buyers here weigh drive time and condition. A house with deferred repairs can be hard to finance, and a cash buyer who purchases as-is offers a way to close without fixing them first.

faqs.q: When is the Barry County deeds counter open?
faqs.a: It posts weekdays from 8:15 a.m. to 4:45 p.m., with a closure from noon to 1:00. Occasional adjusted hours are announced on its page, so call 269-945-1289 before a long drive.

faqs.q: Can I email a deed to Barry County for recording?
faqs.a: No. Plain email cannot be recorded. Send it through an approved provider such as Simplifile, EPN or CSC, or deliver the signed original.

faqs.q: Who is responsible for transfer tax in a Barry County sale?
faqs.a: The seller, per the register's FAQ, and payment falls due at recording. The rate is $4.30 per $500, split as $3.75 to the state and $0.55 to the county.

faqs.q: Can Barry County staff tell me who owns a parcel?
faqs.a: Not directly. Staff can only retrieve the latest deed under a given name. Check the GIS property map for the listed taxpayer, then search that name at a public workstation.

faqs.q: How can I order a copy of a recorded Barry County deed?
faqs.a: The office will mail or email a copy at $1.00 a page, with a $5.00 search charge when you lack the document number. A check has to reach them first, because payment is not taken by email or phone.
